editorial:
Imagine a world that looks like a giant pop-up book where everything folds and unfolds around you. You get to follow Pip, a tiny chipmunk with a huge heart, who finds himself in the middle of a royal mess. He has to rescue a prince from a mean queen who wants all the power for herself. The vibe is bright, colorful, and feels like a classic bedtime story come to life. It is the kind of movie that makes you feel cozy while still keeping you on your toes with plenty of cute animal sidekicks and funny moments.

What really works here is the creative animation and the way the story moves along without feeling too slow. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the charm of the characters makes up for it. You will love the clever ways Pip uses his small size to outsmart the queen's guards. If you want a family night, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the pop-up details. Or, if you love owning movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call.
endingExplained: In the big finale, Pip tricks the evil queen into stepping on a giant pop-up trap that folds her right out of the kingdom. Once she is gone, the prince is finally freed from his spell. The twist is that Pip discovers he is actually a legendary guardian of the forest. Everything wraps up with a huge party where the animals and humans live in peace, and Pip becomes a royal hero.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute animals and magical adventures.
